searchText: Should clients implement a `debug_getBlockAccessList` rpc endpoint for the devnet and if so should it return the BAL in rlp or json format? Besu have it and for the moment we are returning BAL using the json format could you also update the debug_getBadBlock endpoint to add a field `generatedBlockAccessList` to the root of the bad block object such that we can easily debug issues when there is a block access list mismatch for example <https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bal-devnet-0#Besu-debug-endpoint> Ok great, Nimbus EL also returns it as json (implemented today). Sure, will do this as well.
